files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body: - Add occ commands to manage banners from the CLI: `announcementbanner:create`, `announcementbanner:update`, `announcementbanner:delete`, and `announcementbanner:list`, covering message text, colour/variant, schedule window, read-more link, and the dismiss icon, so banners can be scripted (e.g. switching a banner through warning, danger, and success states around a maintenance window).
